name: Those Strange and Intriguing Questions
description: You seem to have caught wind of some Akademiya researchers arguing in Port Ormos. Might as well listen in and find out what's going on, right?

dialogs.content: Atashye! I've tried my best to remain calm, but these reports you keep handing in are useless!
Just look at the things you write! "Possibly," "probably," "roughly"... How am I supposed to build a mathematical model based on uncertainties!?
Th—Th—That's... I don't have enough time! Not to mention, I'm from Kshahrewar! How am I supposed to know how to measure the impacts on living organisms? T—T—Take Fungi as an example...
Wh—Wh—What am I supposed to do with Fungi? Do you want me to stick my hand in one's mouth and let it bite me so I can write down something like "Hmm, that is a surprisingly powerful bite"?
Darwish, you're from the Amurta Darshan, back me up here, will you?
Haha, if you really want me to get involved, I'd have to start by saying that your grasp of basic biology is shockingly poor — surely everyone knows that most Fungi don't have mouths...
Ha!
However, Fadaweh, we don't require an exceedingly precise model this time. Our research isn't aimed at those stuffy old scholars at the Akademiya...
The purpose of this little project is to provide knowledge to children. It's supposed to be engaging. A little imagination is hardly unwarranted.
O—Oh... I see. Well, if you say so...
Hmph! Honestly, Fadaweh. The way you speak to Darwish... You're a whole different person from when you talk to me!
Alright, alright, no need to argue. I've pretty much finished everything I was working on, and I've reviewed Atashye's conclusions.
Besides, the data can be adjusted once the test has concluded. That's the whole point of testing.
A—Ah, of course, Darwish... Clear-headed and organized as always! Unlike a certain someone...
Indeed, indeed... And no, I'm not asking who that "certain someone" is.
Can you two please knock it off? We've got final preparations to make!
A—As you say!
And I'll go check if the paint's dried...
Speaking of the test... and test subjects... I don't suppose you two would be interested in helping out?
I mean, you've been standing there watching us for a while now.
Huh? Us?
Yes, you. Do you want to take part in our test? You'll get to eat all the fruit you want!
Are you asking us to test new varieties of fruit?
Not quite... Hmm. How best to explain...
How about this — I'll start by asking you a question... Let's see... "Who would win in a fight between a sliding Stretchy Pyro Fungus and a Rishboland Tiger?"
The sliding Stretchy Pyro Fungus...
You sure? Paimon feels like the Rishboland Tiger would have the advantage. Y'know, with those long, sharp claws...
That's a very peculiar question...
Wait... there's more. "Who's stronger, a Floating Anemo Fungus or an Anemo Slime?" "Who are the better fighters, the Eremites or Natlan's Saurian Warriors? What about the Kairagi?"...
These are the sort of questions that children always ask when we teach them.
Little minds love asking those sorts of questions!
Haha, but child-like curiosity is the foundation of learning! They "want to know"... and that's why we're doing all this!
Observe — the "Companion Caper Chronicles," based on genuine real-world deductions! The children can build their own simulated adventure teams, then use them to battle each other!
Atashye is researching the effects of diet and environment on all kinds of creatures, while Fadaweh is constructing the "simulated development" model.
Simulated development?
Yes, precisely! I mean, we cannot simply let children freely interact with real-world Fungi, Eremites, and such...
So, what do you say? If you can spare the time, come take part in the test — you'll be helping with my research and gaining valuable academic experience all at once!
#Hmm, that does sound good, doesn't it, {NICKNAME}?
Alright then! "Wise Old Paimon" could do with some academic experience...
Hmph! Don't you make fun of Paimon! Paimon's very smart, she'll have you know — and soon she'll be even smarter! Let's go do some research!
#You're more than welcome to help out, {NICKNAME}. Of course, so is Paimon — a sage in the making if I ever saw one!
Just let me know when you want to give it a go, and I'll run you through our "simulated development" rules.
The Rishboland Tiger, obviously!
Aha! Paimon would've gone for the tiger, too!
That's a very peculiar question...
A sliding Rishboland Tiger would win!
Not an option! What's a sliding Rishboland Tiger anyway?
Who asks crazy questions like that?
Sorry, we're only interested in watching those two argue...
Don't say that! You make it sound like we're a couple of passing weirdos.
Maybe we should hear them out before deciding? Paimon wants to learn more about the fresh fru— Ahem, about this project...
Such an inquisitive mind! I'm sure your travels have been blessed by luck.
Now, let me introduce our research here. Hmm, how best to explain...
So, ready to learn about the "Companion Caper Chronicles"?
Yes. Let's begin.
Alright then, let me just set up the map and game board...
